title: Field Interface
lines: ECHO-7: SignalOS is a computer OS, not the campaign terminal. Use it for local machines, rack storage, notes, and portable field records.
The shell exposes apps for Files, Notes, Logs, Network Monitor, Settings, Data Vault, Echo Link, Missions, Archives, Rewards, and Diagnostics.
Mission completion, claimed rewards, archive read state, notes, preferences, network records, and pending reward counts are server-owned and synced to the client.
Pack content can arrive through Java APIs, datapack JSON, or the soft KubeJS bridge.
